authored_closeout_requirements: All active service jobs stopped and safely released
Each specimen disposition recorded: safe storage,service return or quarantine
Fluid,electrical and waste handling closed by qualified facility
All data stored read-only with hashes and unambiguous measured/simulated labels
Experimental six-cell coverage reconciled with approved repeats/controls
Optional/analytical model families marked inspected,unread,unrun or held
Public/export packet contains authored review only
cleanup_boundary: No new disposal action or recovery procedure authorized; facility-specific rules remain required inputs
mandatory_powered_failure_routing: Successful intermediate stages continue P11 -> P12 -> P13 -> P14. Terminal completion after P14, requested stop, failure or abort at P11-P14 must enter the service-owned P15 release gate. No invalid dataset or early stop bypasses safe release. H_RELEASE retains service custody and blocks retrieval/reorientation.
custody_hold_closeout: If safe release is not established, any administrative closure explicitly preserves the open service custody and hazard obligation. It is not successful episode closeout.
